pattern: 決して～ない（けっして～ない）
purpose: Make a firm negative statement: never or by no means.
keywords: I will never forget this experience.
This road is by no means safe.
You must never reveal someone else’s secret.
restrictions: Use to deny a possibility, make a promise, or state a strong judgment.
mistake: Do not omit the negative predicate.

segments.role: Make a firm negative statement: never or by no means. 決して + negative predicate
